QuestInfo.name: Intelligrabber
QuestInfo.0: Leveling is important, but you have other matters to take care of. Talk to #p1401000# to see what else you have on your schedule.
QuestInfo.1: #p1401000# mentioned that #b#p1401001##k wanted you to drop by. You remember asking her to collect some intelligence on the present-day Black Wings.
QuestInfo.2: #p1401001# seems to be very excited about a new scheme she came up with to gather intel from the Black Wings.

0.0: Taking a training break already, are we? Well, the lovely #b#p1401001##k did mention that she wanted to see you about an assignment you'd given her. \r\n#L0##b#p1401001#? I believe I asked her to get some more information on the Black Wings for me. I'll swing by.#l\n#k
0.1: If you think that's for the best, but I still believe you should be training. Perhaps if the information is not of great urgency... \r\n#L0##bThe value of information is not based on its quantity, but on its timing, my dear Gaston. I didn't hire #p1401001# just for her looks, you know?#l\n#k
0.2: Forgive an old man his questions, master. I am sure your decisions are in the right. \r\n#L0##bNo need for all the grandstanding, Gaston. I am just trying to be certain that the Black Mage does not catch me off guard again. #l\n#k
0.3: Did your stint as an ice cube not suit you, master?\r\n#L0##bI can't say that it did. I was expecting a lot, but even Freud didn't see that last little piece of work coming. When I think of all those levels I lost!#l\n#k
0.4: It's a good thing you've still got your wealth.\r\n#L0##bA great thief hides his stash well. A master thief doesn't need to hide it at all.#l\n#k
0.5: That almost made sense, master. Tell me, why didn't you go to the #p1101000# Knights immediately when you awoke? Wouldn't this be easier with strong allies?\r\n#L0##bA weakling claiming to be a hero is of no use in a battle with the ultimate evil. This way I can help them when they need it and empower myself at the same time.#l\n#k
0.6: You are quite a character, master. Scoundrel and hero wrapped into one never-ending bag of witless one liners.\r\n#L0##bAria would have liked you quite a bit, Gaston. I'm glad I have you at my side to take down the Black Mage.#l\n#k
0.7: I am sure you will be. Now then, I believe you had business at the #bIntelligence Deck#k.

yes.0: Now I see how much you value information.

no.0: Have you changed your mind and decided to train instead?

1.0: Long time, no see, boss. That info you asked for on the Black Wings? I got it.\r\n#L0##bWell done, #p1401001#. If you think it's important enough to pull me away from my training, I'm willing to listen. #l\n#k
1.1: Sure, boss. I know how much you LOVE your training. Look, I found a new way for us to keep track of the Black wings.

npc.0: You haven't gone to the #bIntelligence Center#k yet? I guess the #m150000000# is quite large...
